description: This diagram presents a conceptual cross-section of a landscape, illustrating the spatial arrangement of different land cover elements and substrate types. The left side features a flat area covered by "Grasses" over an unlabelled, light grey substrate. As the landscape rises to the right, forming a slope and an upper plateau, the underlying material changes to "Calcareous substrate," visually represented by a fine grid pattern. Along the lower part of this slope, "Arable land" is depicted. Higher up the slope and on the plateau, "Trees" are present. The legend defines the visual representations: "Calcareous substrate" (grid pattern), "Grasses" (repeating green arch symbols), "Arable land" (small green plant sprout symbols), and "Trees" (small green tree symbols).
